Pharmacist and pharmacy technician jobs at CVS Health, posted pay as of 2026-10-19: typical $20 to $85/hr, median $25/hr (from 298 distinct posted hourly rates; 308 of the 5,129 open jobs post no hourly rate).
Its pharmacist and pharmacy technician jobs by pay: https://carejobs.now/?work=pharmacy&platform=cvs-health&sort=pay&country=all#live-roles. Its pay: https://carejobs.now/employers/cvs-health#pay. Typical pay is the 25th percentile of what jobs pay (the middle of each advertised range) to the 90th-percentile advertised ceiling. Method: https://carejobs.now/methodology.
